parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The full name of the user.

parameters.name: Email
parameters.description:
The email address of the user.

After the user is created, an email is sent to this address. The email contains the Cloud Call Center logon URL, username, and password.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance in which you want to create the user.

parameters.name: LoginName
parameters.description: The logon name of the user.

parameters.name: Phone
parameters.description: The phone number of the user.

parameters.name: PrivateOutboundNumberId
parameters.description: The PhoneNumberId of the personal outbound number.

parameters.name: RoleId
parameters.description: The role ID of the role to assign to the user.

parameters.name: SkillGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the skill group to which the user is assigned.

SkillGroupId.1 indicates that the user is assigned to only one skill group. To assign the user to multiple skill groups, specify multiple values, such as SkillGroupId.1, SkillGroupId.2, and SkillGroupId.3.

parameters.name: SkillLevel
parameters.description:
The skill level corresponding to the skill group that the user joins.

SkillLevel.1 indicates the skill level for SkillGroupId.1. If multiple SkillGroupId values are specified, the same number of SkillLevel values must be specified. For more information, see the request examples below.
